title: The category of quasi-coherent sheaves on an algebraic space is closed under sums, colimits, kernels, tensor products and internal homs
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-properties.tex (Properties of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-properties.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the category of quasi-coherent sheaves on an algebraic space is stable under arbitrary direct sums and colimits, under kernels and cokernels, satisfies the two-out-of-three property for short exact sequences, and is stable under tensor products and under internal homs with a finitely presented first argument (statement lines 5657-5680). The proof (proof lines 5682-5772) reduces to the case of schemes by choosing a surjective etale cover and using that restriction commutes with all limits and colimits and detects quasi-coherence, then verifies the six properties by the corresponding identities for the restriction functor. H2: a reduction followed by six verifications, written out in full.
